2 इष्ट॑ a. sacrificed;
 m. n. sacrifice.

इष्टकामदुह् f. (nom. धुक्) the fabulous wonder cow^1
granting (all) desires.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
इष्टजन m. the beloved person (man or woman).
1 इष्टि॑ f. impulse, furtherance, aid (abstr. & concr.).
2 इष्टि॑ f. seeking, request, wish, desire.
3 इ॑ष्टि f. sacrifice (mostly of a simpler kind).
